Before the fix it was could-not-prove. Full file selftest 287/287, ruff clean, vermin min 3.7, full sweep 335/335 files exit 0. outcome.descriptive: The red-first helper no longer refuses a proof because a sibling file uses the introduced name as a local; it judges the name by the module the AttributeError names.
